verdict.rationale: Cline's docs and community evidence strongly support plain-language, multi-file feature/bug implementation: coordinated multi-file changes with diffs and checkpoints, plan/act workflow, autonomous file edits and command execution, and hands-on user reports of it successfully implementing changes across a codebase (e.g., 'set it loose on my codebase... diff is almost always completely on the money'). missing for 10: independent benchmark or rigorous third-party validation of cross-file correctness, and some community reports note it underperforms alternatives on prompt efficiency, so quality is capped just below best-in-class.
